definitions.explanation: Sexual passion or carnal desire, often carrying a literary or somewhat clinical tone.

examples.japanese: {色情|しきじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{溺|おぼ}れる→溺れる：02026_oboreru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色情|しきじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: That novel has sensuality as its theme.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色情|しきじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{煩悩|ぼんのう}→煩悩：14880_bonnou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{悟|さと}り→悟り：07773_satori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げ→妨げ：12235_samatage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{教|おし}えられる→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: In Buddhism, lust is considered one of the worldly desires and is taught to be an obstacle to enlightenment.

notes:
Composed of {色|しき} (sensual desire; color) + ⟦{情|じょう}→情：03343_jou⟧ (emotion; passion). The kanji {色|しき} has long carried sexual connotations in Japanese, as in {色恋|いろこい} (love affair) and ⟦{好色|こうしょく}→好色：24816_koushoku⟧ (lustful). {色情|しきじょう} is a literary or formal word; everyday speech uses ⟦{性欲|せいよく}→性欲：23807_seiyoku⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色情|しきじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{溺|おぼ}れる→溺れる：02026_oboreru⟧: to be consumed by lust
- {色情|しきじょう}{狂|きょう}: sexual mania; nymphomania
- {色情|しきじょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: sensual; erotic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{性欲|せいよく}→性欲：23807_seiyoku⟧: sexual desire — the standard modern term; more neutral and direct than the literary {色情|しきじょう}
- ⟦{情欲|じょうよく}→情欲：30104_jouyoku⟧: passion; carnal desire — similar register to {色情|しきじょう}, also somewhat literary
- ⟦{好色|こうしょく}→好色：24816_koushoku⟧: lustfulness; lechery — describes the tendency or character of being lustful, rather than the desire itself
